mapper.insert: insert into project_goal (project_id, name, type, is_main, measurement, reach_value, reach_date, create_man_id, create_man) values (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{isMain}, #{measurement}, #{reachValue}, #{reachDate}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.update: update project_goal set is_main = 0 where project_id = #{projectId} and is_main = 1
